visual.general_description: Photographed paper 12-lead ECG with printed header text, three rows of lead segments and a bottom rhythm strip on grid paper.
visual.detailed_description: A photographed paper electrocardiogram tracing on pink-gray grid paper, taken at a slight angle. Along the top is a printed header band: short labelled field lines at the far left, a date/time stamp, a block of small labelled measurement lines with numbers and units, and several lines of printed interpretation text, of which "Sinus rhythm", "Borderline ECG" and "Unconfirmed Diagnosis" are partly legible. Below are three rows of lead segments in a multi-column layout with partly legible lead labels (for example aVR, V1, V2, V3) separated by dashed vertical lines, each row starting with a rectangular calibration pulse, and a full-width rhythm strip along the bottom. Narrow upright and downward deflections occur along each row; the printed text is low resolution and most numeric values cannot be read. Small printed text along the bottom edge includes settings and a facility name line.

visual.general_description: Photographed frontal chest radiograph with dark upper lung zones and a diffusely hazy pale lower thorax on both sides.
visual.detailed_description: A photographed frontal chest radiograph, taken at a slight angle, with a green border along the top and right edges. A small white letter marker is at the upper right and a small round marker is near the center of the lower image. The upper thorax shows dark lung zones on both sides of a central vertical column of vertebral shadows, with rib and clavicle outlines at the sides. The lower half of the image is diffusely pale and hazy across both sides, obscuring the lower lung zones, the heart outline and the diaphragm outlines, with a thin gray band of reduced density along the lateral lower chest on one side. No printed text other than the markers is legible.
